description: Traffic speed camera locations is a dataset listed in ACT Government open data portal (www.data.act.gov.au), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by ACT Government. This dataset provides the locations of all traffic enforcement cameras in the ACT, including locations that have been decommissioned. Location types include fixed speed cameras, red light cameras, point-to-point cameras, and mobile speed camera sites. Usage: "Camera Location Code" can be used to link with the "Traffic and Camera Offences and Fines" dataset. Coverage: Australian Capital Territory. The portal files it under the category Transport. Its tags are point to point camera, red light camera, speed camera, mobile. The table has 13 columns. Attribution on the portal: Access Canberra. The portal shows 2026-08-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-act-gov-au-portal.
